phrases.label: the highest one wins
phrases.fix: say "Precedence, highest first:" and let the ordered list carry the order

phrases.label: outlast
phrases.fix: say "exceeded the timeout", which names the comparison instead of framing it as a contest

phrases.label: fail loudly
phrases.fix: say what actually fails ("fails the whole connection") instead of the volume metaphor

phrases.label: fail silently
phrases.fix: say what happens instead ("fails without an error", "returns an empty result")

phrases.label: means nothing to
phrases.fix: state the scope directly ("these tools operate on the organization, not on a stack")

phrases.label: behaving as intended
phrases.fix: name the behavior ("this is the documented least-privilege behavior")

phrases.label: did not help
phrases.fix: say what happened ("the refresh also failed")

phrases.label: saves <component> a <thing>
phrases.fix: say what the component skips ("lets Contentstack skip an organization lookup")
